# `foxglove datasets episodes update`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](datasets-episodes.md)

```text
Update episode versions selected in the dataset draft

Usage: foxglove datasets episodes update [OPTIONS] <DATASET_ID> <EPISODE_ID>...

Arguments:
  <DATASET_ID>


  <EPISODE_ID>...


Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --episode-version <EPISODE_VERSION>
          Episode version to select for each ID (default: latest)

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
